Agentic product workshop / Build lab

Build the smallest complete experience

Reuse what the project already owns, then make one path coherent from start to finish.

The build path

  1. 1
    Inventory

    Find the components, tokens, data, and routes the project already owns.

  2. 2
    Compose

    Build the smallest path that delivers the requested outcome.

  3. 3
    Render

    Open the experience and compare it with the reference and acceptance checks.

  4. 4
    Refine

    Correct the highest-consequence gap and verify it again.

Choose the complete slice

One end-to-end path

Preferred. Real content, real states, and a visible result that can be reviewed.

best for: learning the whole workflow

Several partial screens

More surface area, but no complete interaction or reliable acceptance check.

best for: later breadth, after the path works

Reuse before adding

Constraint. Ask before adding a new component. Reuse an existing component when it already owns the interaction, semantics, and responsive behavior the task needs.
